memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The land produced vegetation: plants bearing seed according to their kinds and trees bearing fruit with seed in it according to their kinds. And God saw that it was good. - Gen 1:12 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
This verse shows us God's word coming true in full detail. He had said, "Let the land produce vegetation," and now the land does exactly that, plants and trees, each bearing seed "according to their kinds." What God spoke in verse 11 is fulfilled precisely in verse 12. Not one word of His falls short.

There is such steadiness in this. God says it, and then it happens, just as He said. This is who our God is. He is faithful to His own word, down to the smallest detail. When you read His promises in Scripture, you are reading the words of a God who always follows through.

And once more comes that lovely refrain: "God saw that it was good." He looks over the green, growing, fruit-bearing earth and delights in it. Our God is a God who takes joy in His creation. The beauty you see in a garden, an orchard, or a simple potted plant on your windowsill is meant to lift your heart to the good God who made it.

Creation quietly obeys its Maker and fulfils the purpose He gave it. May we do the same, living out the good purpose He has for us in Christ (Eph 2:10), bearing the fruit He designed us to bear, all for His glory and our joy.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Where have you seen God faithfully keep His word in your own life?
2. Are you living out the good purpose God has designed for you?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, You are faithful to fulfil every word You speak. Help me trust Your promises and live out the good purpose You have given me in Christ. Amen.
